MSI.Settings.Style.Name: Indicator style
MSI.Settings.Style.Hint: Choose a thin ring, four minimal corner marks, or a silhouette outline that follows the visible token artwork and ignores transparent pixels.
MSI.Settings.Thickness.Name: Line thickness
MSI.Settings.Thickness.Hint: Thickness relative to Foundry's normal token border.
MSI.Settings.Opacity.Name: Opacity
MSI.Settings.Padding.Name: Indicator padding
MSI.Settings.Padding.Hint: Distance from the token edge as a percentage of the token's smallest dimension. Applies to Ring and Corner brackets; silhouette outline follows the artwork itself.
MSI.Settings.SelectedColor.Name: Selected token color
MSI.Settings.SelectedColor.Hint: Color used for a controlled token.
MSI.Settings.HoverColor.Name: Hovered token color
MSI.Settings.HoverColor.Hint: Color used while hovering a token.
MSI.Preview.Hint: Preview the current values on the canvas without saving or closing this window.
MSI.Preview.Applied: Preview applied. Use Save Changes to keep these values.
MSI.Settings.Glow.Name: Neon glow
MSI.Settings.Glow.Hint: Adds a stronger neon glow around the indicator for both selected and hovered tokens.
MSI.Settings.GlowStrength.Name: Glow intensity
MSI.Settings.GlowStrength.Hint: Controls how wide and bright the neon glow appears. Higher values are intentionally vivid.
